title: Revelation of the Ancient Tianji Record
next_chapter_hook: Mo Xiansheng's residual soul slowly coalesced into form, and a complex emotion flickered in those eyes that had witnessed countless vicissitudes: "Your father's death was no accident... I do know where the complete Tianji Record is located, but the price—you may not be able to bear it."

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice echoed within Chen Ji's Mental Sea like it came from the deepest abyss. He sat cross-legged before the Tianji Record Fragment, fingertips gently touching the yellowed page, feeling the Heavenly Secrets power flowing within. The ancient scroll fragment sent by Ye Qing lay quietly nearby, emanating a faint blue glow, creating a subtle resonance with the Tianji Record.

dialogue.content: "You think you've won? No... You've only just stepped into the entrance of this chess game." Mo Xiansheng's residual soul flickered in and out of visibility in the Void. "That ancient scroll fragment was sealed by your father's own hands. Tonight at the midnight hour, when yin and yang converge, if you wish to know the truth, merge the two pages."

text.content: Chen Ji's brow furrowed slightly, yet his heart was churning with monstrous waves. His father sealed it himself? He had never found even a trace of this matter in his memories. His knuckles whitened from the force, and he took a deep breath, slowly pushing the ancient scroll fragment toward the third page of the Tianji Record. The moment the two pages touched, a blinding golden light erupted.

Within the golden light, a vague figure slowly manifested. It was the back view of a middle-aged man, wearing a Tianqing Sect robe, his spine straight as a pine, hands cradling that very Tianji Record. Chen Ji's pupils constricted—that familiar silhouette, that figure recognizable even if reduced to dust.

dialogue.content: "My name is Chen Tianming, the seventeenth generation inheritor of the Tianji Record." The phantom spoke, his voice aged and weary. "My son Chen Ji, if you can see this residual image, it proves you've reached the same realm your father once occupied. However, I must tell you—the Tianji Record is not an opportunity, but a shackle."

text.content: Shackle? Chen Ji's heart trembled violently, yet he forced himself to remain calm. He silently carved his father's words into his Mental Sea, revealing nothing on his face. Deep within his Mental Sea, the忍辱负重 and disguise of atrash杂役 had been etched into his bones. He waited quietly, waiting for his father to unveil this dust-laden secret.

dialogue.content: "Father, please speak." Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly steady, as if discussing something utterly unrelated to himself. "How is this shackle to be broken?"

text.content: Chen Tianming's phantom turned slowly, revealing a face seventy percent similar to Chen Ji's, yet covered in the ravines of time. His eyes flickered with guilt and helplessness: "The Tianji Record was forged by the Heavenly Dao's will, serving as a tool to seal those who possess the Heavenly Fate Key. Your sister Chen Nian is precisely the Heavenly Fate Key... And you are merely a discarded piece set up by the Heavenly Dao."

choice.prompt: Father's words struck like thunder, and Chen Ji felt his years of understanding collapsing. How should he face this sudden truth?

choices.description: Continue deeply investigating the cause of father's death, exploring who designed this chess game spanning decades.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain critical intelligence: Forces hidden behind father's death
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate is scarce to begin with; continued consumption may endanger one's life

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze was sharp as a blade,直视 his father's phantom: "Father, you did not die from an accident, did you?" Before the words finished, the Tianji Record shuddered violently, a blood-colored light shooting from the third page directly into Chen Ji's Brow Center. Agonizing pain struck, and countless images flashed through his Mental Sea like a carousel—conspiracy, poison, silencing of witnesses...

choices.text: Temporarily suppress it, digest this information first
choices.description: The matter of father's death runs too deep; this is not the optimal time for thorough investigation. Should stabilize the foundation before making calculations.
choices.visible_reward: Preserve Heavenly Fate, maintain the secrecy of the current layout
choices.risk_hint: The truth may be buried forever, missing the best opportunity for investigation

text.content: Chen Ji slowly gathered his scattered thoughts, forcibly suppressing the surging emotions. He lowered his eyes, his voice low and calm: "Your son has noted this. But the timing is not yet ripe, Father, please continue speaking of this shackle." As he spoke, his fingertips trembled slightly, betraying the turbulence within.

Chen Tianming's phantom was silent for a moment, seemingly feeling a trace of relief, or perhaps sorrow, at his son's composure. He continued: "Each use of the Tianji Record consumes not only Heavenly Fate, but the contract with the Heavenly Dao's will. When the contract depletes all of the holder's fortune, the holder will become the Heavenly Dao's puppet... or die."

dialogue.content: Ye Qing, who had been silently observing, suddenly spoke, and a solemn shadow flickered across her enchanting features: "Chen Ji, regarding the Heavenly Fate Key matter, I have heard of its记载 in Demonic Path classics. If your sister truly is this thing... the Holy Sect's abduction of her back then was probably for refining some kind of forbidden item."

text.content: Chen Ji's heart sank heavily. Chen Nian, the sister who had been missing for years, the close relative he had never stopped searching for. He remembered her innocent, radiant smile from childhood, remembered her heart-wrenching cries on the day she was taken. Now, she had become a forbidden sacrifice? His knuckles clenched tight, bones creaking.

choice.prompt: Ye Qing's words were like a blade, stabbing into the softest place in Chen Ji's heart. How should he choose?

choices.text: Search for Chen Nian at Any Cost
choices.description: Regardless of Chen Nian's role in the Tianji Record, she is always my sister. Even if it means becoming an enemy of the Heavenly Dao, so be it.
choices.visible_cost: May provoke direct erasure by the Heavenly Dao's will
choices.visible_reward: Gain Ye Qing's deep trust, unlock shared access to the "Demonic Path Mist" skill
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye's gaze will become even more intense

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly raised his head, a desperate madness flickering in his eyes: "Sister... I will definitely find her." His voice was low and firm, like a blood oath standing in darkness. Ye Qing gazed at his face contorted with rage, and an inexplicable flutter stirred in her heart.

choices.text: Plan Carefully, Arrange Secretly in the Shadows
choices.description: The Chen Nian matter cannot be rushed; need to first thoroughly understand the Holy Sect's details, then slowly scheme. Reckless action will only lead to total defeat.
choices.visible_cost: Action delayed, Chen Nian's situation may deteriorate
choices.visible_reward: Maintain layout integrity, obtain more intelligence about the Holy Sect
choices.risk_hint: The longer the delay, the greater the risk of Chen Nian being alchemized

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcibly pressing the blazing anger deep into his chest. He turned to Ye Qing, his voice returning to its usualplain: "This matter requires careful planning. Ye Qing, how much do you know about the Holy Sect's布局?" A cold smile curved his lips, yet his eyes held bottomless coldness.

Just then, the golden characters on the third page of the Tianji Record flickered again, and a segment of dust-laden text slowly emerged: "The Tianji Record consists of nine pages, scattered throughout the world. Those who gather them all may peer into the complete picture of Heavenly Secrets, and may also break the shackles, reshaping destiny. However—on the day all are gathered, is when Heavenly Fate is depleted."

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's residual soul manifested once more, his voice carrying a trace of fatigue and compassion: "Young master, your father died precisely while pursuing the third page. He discovered the truth, but also angered certain... beings that should not have been angered. I received his dying entrustment and have guarded this page until now."

choice.prompt: Mo Xiansheng finally revealed more details about his father's death. Chen Ji felt the crushing weight of fate, yet also caught the scent of conspiracy.

choices.text: Question Mo Xiansheng About the True Culprit's Identity
choices.description: Since Mo Xiansheng knows the cause of father's death, he should speak clearly. Hiding and obscuring is not how an ally acts.
choices.visible_cost: May create discord with Mo Xiansheng
choices.visible_reward: Obtain direct clues, narrow down the scope of the mastermind
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng may be holding back, unwilling to reveal everything

text.content: Chen Ji stepped forward sharply, his gaze electric, stabbing directly into the depths of Mo Xiansheng's residual soul: "Since you know, then speak clearly. Who exactly killed my father?!" Mo Xiansheng was intimidated by this气势, his residual soul trembling slightly. Only after a long while did he say: "...I only know that person is among the three great sects."

choices.description: Mo Xiansheng's words contained deeper meaning—there's a sect insider among the three great sects. Now is not the time to stir up trouble; should investigate secretly.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain critical intelligence: An insider exists within the three great sects
choices.risk_hint: If the insider becomes aware, they may strike first
choices.process_label: still water runs deep, hidden thunder

text.content: Chen Ji's expression remained unchanged, only deeply concealing his gaze. He nodded slightly, his tone as usualplain: "Thank you for the reminder, sir." Yet Ye Qing saw his fingers within his sleeves already tightly clenched, fingernails digging deeply into his palms. The three great sects... he had noted it.

Night deepened, and the golden light on the Tianji Record gradually dimmed. The final message left by Chen Tianming slowly appeared on the paper: "My son, the path I could not complete, I hope you will walk for me. But remember—under the Heavenly Dao, all are chess pieces. Only by breaking the chessboard can one transcend reincarnation. Chen Nian is within the Heavenly Eye; saving her is also saving yourself."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji gazed at his father's dissipating phantom, a bitter, self-mocking smile curving his lips: "Father, you said under the Heavenly Dao all are chess pieces. But if this chessboard was set up for me alone, why should I play by their rules?" He turned to Ye Qing, a trace of determination flickering in his eyes, "From this day forward, I am no one's chess piece."

text.content: Ye Qing quietly gazed at this young man before her, an indescribable emotion welling in her heart. She had seen too many weak ones crushed by fate, yet never had she witnessed someone, upon learning they were merely a discarded piece, still erupt with such astonishing battle intent. She softly said: "Chen Ji, the path you walk will be very bitter."

Chen Ji gave no answer, only lowering his gaze to the broken Tianji Record in his hands. Once he had thought this was an opportunity to change his fate, now he understood it was merely another layer of shackles. But so what? He was originally a solitary ghost crawling out from the ruins of waste; even heaven had never shown him the slightest favor. Since that was the case, why not fight with heaven, contend with destiny?

Just then, Mo Xiansheng's residual soul coalesced into form once more. Those eyes that had witnessed countless vicissitudes flickered with a complex expression: "Young master, this old servant has words to say, uncertain if they should be spoken." Chen Ji raised his eyes, saying calmly: "Speak." Mo Xiansheng took a deep breath, his residual soul trembling slightly: "Your father's death... this old servant not only knew of it, but witnessed every detail of that murder."

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's residual soul slowly raised its head,直视 Chen Ji's eyes: "The complete Tianji Record is divided into nine pages, distributed throughout the world. Your father exhausted his entire life yet only obtained three of them. The fourth page is..." He paused, a flicker of hesitation in his eyes, "...deep within the Tianqing Sect's Forbidden Grounds, personally guarded by the old sect leader Ling Yuan."

text.content: Ling Yuan? Chen Ji's pupils slightly contracted. That old sect leader who had shown him such "care and concern," that Tianqing Sect power holder whose surface benevolence concealed unfathomable depths. He should have thought of it earlier—if his father was a Tianqing Sect disciple, how could the fourth page of the Tianji Record fall into an outsider's hands? So it turned out—the origin of everything had been lurking by his side for years. A cold, grim smile curved his lips as Chen Ji softly murmured: "Ling Yuan... what a fine Ling Yuan indeed."
